relations.subject: Tavivat Puntarigvivat
relations.role: Director of the Institute of Research and Development
relations.evidence: Tavivat Puntarigvivat is currently a member of the Subcommittee on Ethics of the Thai Senate, and the Director of the Institute of Research and Development at the World Buddhist University located in Bangkok, Thailand.

relations.subject: Tavivat Puntarigvivat
relations.role: chairman of the graduate program in Comparative Religion
relations.evidence: He was the chairman of the graduate program in Comparative Religion and was responsible for initiating the graduate program in Religion and Development at Mahidol University in Thailand.

relations.evidence: Tavivat Puntarigvivat received his B.A. in Economics (Thammasat University)

relations.subject: Tavivat Puntarigvivat
relations.evidence: M.A. in Philosophy (University of Hawaii) under the Rockefeller Fellowship

relations.subject: Tavivat Puntarigvivat
relations.evidence: also a researcher on "Zen Buddhism" at Kyoto University in Japan, with the Monbusho Scholarship program.

relations.subject: Tavivat Puntarigvivat
relations.evidence: he was a bhikkhu (Buddhist monk) for a phansa (a monastic retreat of three months during the Thai rainy season) in 1980 and practiced Dynamic Meditation under Luangpor Teean's guidance.
